WITH aylik AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', tarih) AS ay, SUM(adet * birim_fiyat * (1 - COALESCE(indirim_orani, 0))) AS net_ciro
  FROM siparis GROUP BY ay
)
SELECT ay, net_ciro, net_ciro - LAG(net_ciro) OVER (ORDER BY ay) AS onceki_aya_fark
FROM aylik
ORDER BY ay

SELECT odeme_turu,
  COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN iade = 'evet' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iade_sayisi,
  1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN iade = 'evet' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS iade_orani
FROM siparis
GROUP BY odeme_turu

SELECT s.musteri_id, m.segment, SUM(s.adet * s.birim_fiyat * (1 - COALESCE(s.indirim_orani, 0))) AS net_ciro
FROM siparis s
JOIN musteri m ON m.musteri_id = s.musteri_id
WHERE s.iade = 'hayır'
GROUP BY s.musteri_id, m.segment
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC
LIMIT 3
